translations.web: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
translations.bsb: He made ten gold lampstands according to their specifications and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north.
translations.kjv: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
translations.asv: And he made the ten candlesticks of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
